description: Exploit the (NEAR-)NULL-SPACE complement structure in the rankdef (shape 8, 90.7ms) and nearrank (shape 10, 107ms) low-rank paths -- the two biggest low-rank shapes never given shape-specific attention (all prior low-rank work targeted shape 3 dense). STRUCTURE: shape 8 rankdef512 cond=0 has EXACTLY 128 zero eigenvalues + 384 in [0.1,1] (rank 384=3n/4); shape 10 nearrank1024 cond=0 has 256 tiny (~1e-6) + 768 in [0.1,1]. The current GENERIC low-rank path projects onto the k=384/768 dominant subspace and builds an (n-k)-column COMPLEMENT that it orthonormalizes via CQR2 + runs through the gate -- but for these shapes the complement IS the (near-)null space with eigenvalue ~0, so its eigenpairs are trivially (L=0, any orthonormal null basis). PROBE FIRST (cheap, no commit): profile shapes 8/10 on the current best to measure how much time the COMPLEMENT branch (Vc CQR2 + its projection Vc-Qd(Qd^T Vc) + the complement's share of the gate) costs vs the dominant branch; and check whether the complement eigenvalues the path computes are ~0 (confirming they're the null space). STEP 2 if the complement is a material cost: for detected rank-deficient inputs (cheap check: the dominant-subspace residual ||A - Qd Bk Qd^T|| is already ~0, i.e. A's energy is fully in the k-subspace so the complement is null), SKIP the complement eigenvalue machinery -- assign L=0 to the complement block and take Vc as just an orthonormal basis of the projected-out complement (single CQR pass, no second CQR2 pass, no Rayleigh on the complement, minimal gate). The dominant k-block keeps the existing split-mega inner solve + gate. Per-matrix residual-gated cuSOLVER fallback catches any matrix that's not actually rank-deficient. If the complement is already cheap / the path already short-circuits it (probe negative), refute cleanly with the profile numbers. PURE-TORCH (low-rank path branch logic; no nvcc) -- GPU-light amid contention. DISTINCT from brief-32 (shape 9), brief-33 (shape 6 psd), brief-19 (trsm-free, refuted), brief-16 (shape-3 precision). Forks best a7f01e4d; no 'stream' substring; verify 39/39 + quiet re-bench beats 35659 (or refute).

t1 REFUTE reduced-CQR: probed complement branch on shapes 8/10 (9.0ms/6.0ms = 9.6%/5.5% of shape, ~97% orthonormalization CQR2+proj, ~0.27ms eigenvalue machinery; lam_c~2e-5/1.8e-5 confirm null; ||A@Vc||/||A|| 1.2e-3/9e-4 << eigen gate). Dropped final complement CQR to 1 pass -> full-V orth exceeds 80*n*eps gate on ALL low-rank shapes -> mass fallback. shape8 94k->111.7k (+18%), geomean 35659->36928 (+3.6%). 39/39.

t2 REFUTE skip-proj0: dropped the pre-CQR Qd projection of R (kept both CQR 2-pass). 100% fallback on ALL low-rank shapes; geomean 35659->54771 (+54%). proj0 is load-bearing: without pre-projecting R into Qd-complement, CQR2a leaves large Qd-coupling reproj+2nd-CQR2 cannot clear. 39/39.

t3 REFUTE TF32 Newton-Schulz complement: replaced 2nd CQR2 with 2 TF32 NS iters (pure GEMM, no chol/trsm). TF32 NS plateaus ~1e-2 orth (>gate) -> mass fallback; geomean 35659->48295 (+35%). FP32 NS would pass but ~18x the Gram cost -> would regress. CQR2 stays the complement orthonormalizer. 39/39.

t4 double-reproj + 1-pass final CQR (UNGATED): 2 reprojs kill cross-block coupling so a single final CQR clears the gate. WORKS for null shapes 8/10 (shape8 94k->92.8k, shape10 neutral, PASS) but the less-null shapes fall back (shape6 134->151.8k, shape12 34->43.7k) -> geomean 35659->36641 (+2.8%). Signal: valid ONLY for truly-null complements; must be GATED. 39/39.

t5 GATED null-complement reduction (BEST, ~neutral): thread null_complement flag from the rank-deficient PR bands (rankdef512 PR[120,200], nearrank1024 PR[200,400], both null=True) through router->_eigh_lowrank_safe->_lowrank_eigh; null bands use double-reproj+1-CQR, concentrated bands (3/4/12) + mixed peels keep 2+2 CQR2. PR band IS the null discriminator (cheap ||AQd||/||A|| ratio was ~0.9999 for ALL low-rank shapes, could not separate). QUIET head-to-head vs parent 5c66a54b3: shape8 93.23k->92.88k (-0.38%, real & stable), shape10 108.87k->108.76k (noise), geomean 35592->35589 (neutral, within noise). Complement is too small a fraction for partial reduction to move geomean. 39/39; per-matrix gate still guards every matrix; grep stream=0.

t6 REFUTE null-branch with NO final CQR: dropped the single final CQR after the double-reproj. shape8 92.8k->166.4k, shape10 108.7k->181.3k, mass fallback (geomean 35589->38709, +8.7%). Reproj shrinks Vc columns un-normalized so internal orth drifts off the gate without a finishing CQR. Confirms t5 (double-reproj + 1 final CQR) is the MINIMUM null-complement orthonormalization. HEAD reverted to t5 code (best). 39/39.

BEST/final: gated double-reproj+1-CQR for the rank-deficient bands (rankdef512/nearrank1024), full 2+2 CQR2 elsewhere. FINAL quiet full bench: geomean 35598us (parent 5c66a54b3 quiet ~35592, neutral); shape8 93.08k (parent 93.23k, -0.16% this run; -0.38% mean over 3+2 runs), shape10 108.66k (neutral). Correctness-safe 39/39, per-matrix gate intact, grep stream=0. Complement branch is a small (9.6%/5.5%) irreducible fraction so the partial reduction is sub-noise at geomean.

brief-34 (null-complement of rankdef512 shape8 / nearrank1024 shape10). PROBE (on 5c66a54b3, per-shape CUDA-event timing): complement branch = 9.0ms of shape8's ~93.7ms (9.6%) and 6.0ms of shape10's ~109ms (5.5%). Breakdown shape8: proj0=1.27 + CQR2a(2pass)=3.11 + reproj=1.24 + CQR2b(2pass)=3.09 + AVc+Rayleigh=0.27ms -> ~97% is ORTHONORMALIZATION, only ~0.27ms is 'eigenvalue machinery'. Complement eigenvalues CONFIRMED ~0 (lam_c|max 2.8e-5 shape8 / 1.8e-5 shape10); ||A@Vc||/||A|| = 1.2e-3 / 9.0e-4 << eigen gate 9.2e-3 / 1.8e-2, so L=0 clears the eigen gate with margin.

BRIEF PREMISE PARTLY REFUTED: the skippable 'eigenvalue machinery' (Rayleigh+AVc) is only ~0.27ms; the cost is orthonormalization, and the BINDING constraint is ORTHOGONALITY of full V=[Vd,Vc] (not eigenvalue accuracy), which the null structure does NOT relax. Refuted reductions (all mass-fallback via full-V orth > 80*n*eps): t1 final-CQR->1pass (+18% shape8, +3.6% geo), t2 skip-proj0 (+54% geo), t3 TF32 Newton-Schulz (+35% geo, TF32 NS plateaus ~1e-2), t6 double-reproj+NO-final-CQR (+8.7% geo). The proj0->CQR2->reproj->CQR2 4-op structure is MINIMAL; a cheap pre-detector (||AQd||/||A|| energy ratio) was ~0.9999 for ALL low-rank shapes and cannot separate null from concentrated.

BEST (HEAD 6c9fdfff4, code == t5 11acba51e): GATE a double-reproj+1-CQR reduction to the RANK-DEFICIENT PR bands (rankdef512 PR[120,200], nearrank1024 PR[200,400], marked null=True; concentrated bands 3/4/12 + mixed dense/psd peels keep 2+2 CQR2). The PR band IS the null discriminator (rank-deficient shapes sit in HIGH-PR bands >=120, cleanly split from concentrated <120). QUIET head-to-head vs parent 5c66a54b3: shape8 93.23k->92.88k (-0.38%, real & stable across 3v2 runs), shape10 neutral, GEOMEAN 35592->35589 NEUTRAL (within ~1% noise). Correctness 39/39, per-matrix gate intact, grep stream=0. It's a safe, principled, sub-noise micro-win -- neutral because the complement is a small irreducible fraction.

OPEN DIRECTIONS (complement too small to move geomean alone; bigger levers are OUTSIDE this brief's scope): (1) shape8's 93ms is dominated by the DOMINANT block -- mega_eigh_med_split_k = 33.9ms/37.7% of the profiled capture (k=384 split megakernel) + its CQR2 range-finder + back-transform; a faster dominant solve for the rank-deficient k=384/768 case is where the real time is. (2) shape10 (nearrank1024, k=768) routes k>448 so its dominant reduced-eigh is on cuSOLVER (the _lr_reduced_eigh k>448 floor) -- a batched dense solver for k in (448,768] would help shape10 AND shape4(k608). (3) the SHARED gate does a full n-width _gram_3xtf32(V) orthogonality GEMM; for a verified-null complement the Vc^T Vc / Vd^T Vc blocks are known-good by construction, so a null-aware gate could skip part of the n^3 orth GEMM (touches shared gate, needs a fresh brief). (4) FP32 Newton-Schulz would clear the gate (~3e-6) but costs ~18x the Gram -- unless a cheaper NS variant (fewer iters from the CQR2a-conditioned start) fits.
